'''Tripp Rar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] and wealthy hunter during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was one of four hunters who resided in [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy]] and established big-game hunting safaris within the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Unlike her fellow associates [[Ziven Tissak]] and [[Sordaan Xris]], Tripp hunted purely for the fun of it. She tried to stay out of the unnecessary political conflicts that plagued the others.
